title: Longhair · coats that need a brush
blurb: The Persian line and the northern forest cats: heavy coats, ruffled necks and a build made for cold winters.

items.d: The flat-faced longhair of the Victorian drawing room, bred for centuries for coat and calm.
America's largest native breed: 4–8 kg, a shaggy coat, a raccoon tail and a friendly dog-like manner.
The skogkatt of Norway: a double coat, a strong climber and a saga name to match.
Russia's forest cat, with a triple coat and an oily top layer that sheds snow.
A pointed longhair bred in California in the 1960s, known for going limp when lifted.
The sacred cat of Burma: cream body, dark points and four white gloves.
The fine-boned white longhair of Ankara, kept as a national treasure in Turkey.
The swimming cat of Lake Van, with a chalk-white body and colour confined to head and tail.
